title: Artifacts of the Dead Gods
notes: Artifacts: 13 new trinkets, things the dead gods owned or used but weren't known for, each still holding a little of its god. Kryu's Primer (half your damage becomes Void: holy and shadow at once), Feeding Bowl of Kryu, Kryu's Lantern, Gylvor's Morningstar, Gylvor's Inkwell, Gylvor's Seal Ring, Vyl's Hourglass, Vyl's Abacus, Vyl's Garden Shears, XyloFel's Potter's Wheel, XyloFel's Chisel, XyloFel's Kiln Ember (spiralling embers for fire builds) and XyloFel's Sample Jar. Large or Grand in size, they change how a build plays. One of each counts.

Super Unique Trinkets are much smaller: 2x4 instead of 2x9 (yours shrink too), so there's room for other trinkets around them. Their stats count at 80% to make up for it; granted skills and auras are unchanged.
The same skill or aura from more than one trinket now stacks: the levels add up (two trinkets granting Fireball 4 give Fireball 8). Auras merge into one stronger aura, Brood charms' minion auras too.
Artifacts drop from item level 30 (about Ascension 10) and from guardians.
